title: 18836 - 18836/P2404/009220
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses:
Faulty Leak Detection Pump (V144)
Electrical issue, fails ohm testing
Mechanical failure, fails vacuum testing
Voltage supply problems to Leak Detection Pump (V144)
Low or no vacuum supply to the Leak Detection Pump (V144)
Evaporative Emission (EVAP) Canister System leaking pressure
stepByStepSolution:
Test Leak Detection Pump (V144) and it's wiring, see repair manual
Kontrol edin:  voltage supply to Leak Detection Pump (V144) including J757 - Engine Component Power Supply Relay when applicable
Kontrol edin:  voltage supply to Leak Detection Pump (V144) including J757 - Engine Component Power Supply Relay when applicable
Test vacuum supply to Leak Detection Pump (V144) with engine at idle
Pressure test Evaporative Emission (EVAP) Canister System for leaks, see repair manual
Test (N80) Evap purge solenoid for leaking system pressure into the Emme Manifoldu
technicalNotes:
If found on:
2.0L BPY engine, see Technical Bulletin 20-07-13.
2011 - 2014 Touareg 3.6L, see Tech Tip 20-13-04TT for possible coolant pump issue.
https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2017/MC-10157825-9999.pdf   NHSTA
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: VW/Audi models that use a J757 (Engine Component Power Supply Relay) to supply power to the Leak Detection Pump (V144), Kontrol edin: the relay and power supply to V144 itself closely before replacing the pump.  Faulty J757 relays often cause this DTC in the (4F) Audi A6.
Case Study of P2404 due to no vacuum supply at the Leak Detection Pump (V144).
model: Cayenne, Macan, Panamera, 911, Taycan, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8, Leon, Ibiza, Ateca, Arona, Tarraco, Octavia, Superb, Kodiaq, Karoq, Fabia, Scala, Passat, Golf, Jetta, Tiguan, Polo, Arteon, Touareg, Transporter, Caddy, Amarok, Scirocco
